title: Barnes & Noble names Incorruptible one of the Best Business Books of 2026
summary: The largest bookstore chain in the United States puts Incorruptible on its annual business list — 31 titles, chosen by B&N's own editorial team, alongside Unreasonable Hospitality, Planet Money and The Nerd Reich. B&N's booksellers describe the book by its argument rather than its author's reputation: structural failures that cause corporate corruption, and how to avoid them. Retail curation of this kind reaches the shelf and the table rather than the trade press, which is a different kind of reach from a review.
blockquote: Author of The Lean Startup Eric Ries identifies the structural failures that cause corporate corruption and how to avoid these predictable pitfalls.
blockquote_source: Barnes & Noble, The Best Business Books of 2026
